name: Homestead Gold and Silver Ltd
summary: Homestead Gold and Silver Ltd. operates primarily as a mobile technology integrator and a worldwide publisher of wireless content, with a key specialization in the marketing and distribution of this mobile content. The company also acts as a reseller and deployment partner, handling the planning, installation, and implementation of wireless communication systems. This includes providing, setting up, and managing integrated wireless network infrastructures that guarantee constant, anywhere, anytime mobile broadband access. Additionally, they offer integrated order management solutions for their distributor and dealer networks, facilitating the immediate dissemination of catalog products and services and simplifying the ordering process for both computer and mobile device users. The company, which was previously known as Sunland Media Group, changed its name to Homestead Gold and Silver Ltd. in September 2011 and is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.
